evidence.title: Proliferate Current Git functions
evidence.finding: Workspace-scoped status/diff/stage/unstage/commit/push/revert and hosting PR read model. Base-worktree review compares committed/staged/unstaged/untracked content.

evidence.title: Proliferate Current agent authentication
evidence.finding: Managed gateway, own API/provider config and Claude Max seat credential. Native login is a permanent supported fallback when configured/detected; managed auth optional. Launch fails if unconfigured.

evidence.title: Proliferate Current workflow engine

evidence.title: Proliferate Current artifacts

evidence.title: Proliferate runtime PR routes (desktop-v0.1.36)
evidence.finding: At the desktop-v0.1.36 release commit, the bundled runtime exposes workspace-scoped GitHub CLI-backed routes to read the current pull request and to create a pull request.

evidence.title: Proliferate gh pr create adapter (desktop-v0.1.36)
evidence.finding: create_pr runs gh pr create with title, body and base branch, and adds --draft when requested. It requires the user's installed and authenticated GitHub CLI.

evidence.title: Proliferate desktop publish workflow (desktop-v0.1.36)
evidence.finding: The desktop publish flow builds a stage, commit, push and create_pull_request step sequence for a workspace.

evidence.title: Proliferate SSO removal

evidence.title: Proliferate: anyharness/crates/anyharness-lib/src/domains/agents/model.rs
evidence.finding: The native runtime has a closed AgentKind enum and parser for Claude, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and Grok. Other names are rejected by parse; no generic provider-adapter registration path is exposed in the inspected runtime. Broad README wording does not add a working adapter.

evidence.title: Proliferate: specs/systems/workspaces/README.md
evidence.locator: Owned state, public surface and code map; anyharness workspace model/store and server database models
evidence.finding: The current workspace contract persists local/worktree checkout identities, branches and active/archived lifecycle. Inspection of the native runtime domains, API contracts and control-plane models for issue/task/ticket entities found sessions, workspace lifecycle and workflow runs, but no accessible independent native issue tracker. The current local workspace implementation provisions clones and worktrees, not containers or VMs.

evidence.title: Proliferate: specs/systems/automations/README.md
evidence.locator: Known gaps, Triggers other than a human click; public surface; trigger-courier.ts
evidence.finding: The current automation contract explicitly says the only trigger is a human click through the client courier. Schedules, webhooks, Slack mentions, external API intake and a server courier are listed as not implemented targets. Saved workflow definitions and manually started multi-node runs do not establish unattended triggers.

evidence.title: Proliferate: anyharness/crates/anyharness/src/commands/serve.rs
evidence.finding: The public anyharness CLI starts the full runtime HTTP server on an operator-selected host and port with its own runtime home and optional bearer authentication. Session creation starts a runtime-owned ACP actor before returning the HTTP response. The published Linux runtime binary can therefore run agent execution on an operator-controlled server independently of the browser/client connection; this requires operator deployment, not managed Proliferate hosting.

evidence.title: Proliferate: specs/systems/agent_auth/README.md
evidence.locator: Managed gateway, own provider configuration and native-login fallback
evidence.finding: The current runtime supports user-supplied provider API configuration and native coding-agent login as alternatives to the optional managed gateway.
